prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2019 — Summary (≤500 words)

Core purpose and headline pledge
- Stop Brexit to “build a brighter future.” If winning a majority, revoke Article 50; otherwise back a People’s Vote with the option to remain. Claim a £50bn “Remain Bonus” to invest in services and reduce inequality.

Economy, work and tech
- Invest £130bn in infrastructure (transport, energy, schools, hospitals, housing) and a £50bn Regional Rebalancing Programme, plus a Green Investment Bank.
- Skills Wallet: £10,000 per adult for lifelong learning; expand apprenticeships; introduce a wellbeing budget and Minister for Wellbeing.
- R&D to 3% of GDP; support regional innovation; pro–creative industries; nationwide fibre broadband.
- Fair taxes: restore Corporation Tax to 20%; replace Business Rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy; tougher action on multinational avoidance; scrap Marriage Allowance.
- Future of work: new “dependent contractor” status; flexible working from day one; genuine Living Wage review; rights for gig workers; prompt payment enforcement; employee board reps.

Education and childcare
- Free, high‑quality childcare from 9 months for working parents (35 hours, 48 weeks); triple Early Years Pupil Premium; £1bn for Children’s Centres.
- Reverse school cuts; hire 20,000 teachers; fund SEND; fix buildings backlog.
- Scrap SATs and Ofsted, replace with broader assessments and a new inspectorate; introduce a “curriculum for life.”
- FE/HE: +£1bn for colleges, reinstate maintenance grants, Student Mental Health Charter.

Climate, nature and transport
- Net zero by 2045; at least 80% renewable electricity by 2030; ban fracking.
- Insulate all homes by 2030; zero‑carbon new homes by 2021 (Passivhaus by 2025).
- EV-only new car and small van sales by 2030; rail network ultra‑low‑emission by 2035; expand trams, buses and cycling; Clean Air Act.
- Nature Act; plant 60m trees/year; restore peatlands and wetlands; 70% recycling target; deposit return schemes; ban non‑recyclable single‑use plastics.

Health and social care
- Raise £7bn/yr via a 1p Income Tax rise for the NHS and social care; £10bn capital upgrade; move toward a dedicated Health & Care Tax and integrated local budgets; end automatic tendering.
- Mental health “parity”: new waiting time standards; 24/7 crisis care; liaison teams in all hospitals; perinatal support; free prescriptions for chronic mental ill‑health.
- Workforce plan to end GP shortfall; targeted bursaries; ethical international recruitment; stronger support for carers and end‑of‑life care.

Fair society, housing and justice
- Welfare: cut first UC wait to 5 days; abolish two‑child limit, benefit cap and bedroom tax; right to food; link housing allowance to rents; replace sanctions with incentives; end WCAs; end fuel poverty by 2025.
- Pensions: keep Triple Lock; compensate WASPI women.
- Housing: build 300,000 homes/year incl. 100,000 social; zero‑carbon standards; Rent to Own; 3‑year tenancies; tougher landlord licensing; end rough sleeping in five years.
- Policing and crime: £1bn for community policing; public health approach to violence; £500m for youth services; Online Crime Agency; presumption against short prison sentences; expand rehab and restorative justice.

Rights, migration and democracy
- Defend the Human Rights Act/ECHR; restore £500m legal aid; halt police facial recognition; data/AI ethics code; complete GRA reform; BSL Act; end period poverty.
- Immigration: scrap hostile environment; 28‑day detention limit; post‑study work visas; flexible work visas; end spouse MIR; right to work for asylum seekers after 3 months; resettle 10,000 refugees/year and 10,000 unaccompanied children over 10 years.
- Politics: STV for all elections; votes at 16; votes for EU citizens (5+ years) and all UK citizens abroad; automatic registration; Lords reform; federal UK with stronger devolution.

International
- Pro‑EU, pro‑multilateralism; spend 0.7% GNI on aid; global climate leadership; tighter arms controls (suspend Saudi sales); Magnitsky law; recognise Palestine; support Hong Kong BNOs.
- Defence: meet 2% NATO target; boost cyber; maintain minimum nuclear deterrent (3 submarines).
